title_sq: DUBLEX NE SHITJE, I VENDOSUR TEK RRUGA E KAVAJES, TIRANE!

title_en: DUPLEX FOR SALE, LOCATED ON KAVAJA STREET, TIRANA!
description_en: Duplex for sale with an area of ​​190 m2, located at the entrance to Kavaje Street, near Skenderbej Square. It is located on the 7th floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. It is currently rented out as an office space. Located near the center of Tirana, an ideal investment and residential opportunity. With regular mortgage documentation. For more information and a visit to the property, you can contact us!
